title: Flattening equal-length blocks
statement: Let $u$ be a list over a type $\alpha$, and let $w,m$ be natural numbers. If $u$ has length $wm$, then $u$ is the concatenation, in order, of the $m$ consecutive blocks of length $w$ obtained by taking the first $w$ entries after dropping the first $wj$ entries, for $j=0,\ldots,m-1$.
